title: REsolved ALMA and SMA Observations of Nearby Stars (REASONS): A population of 74 resolved planetesimal belts at millimetre wavelengths
question: What are the spatial properties (radius, width, vertical aspect ratio) and evolution of mm-resolved planetesimal belts across a uniformly modelled population of 74 systems?

data.bands: Band 6 (1.27 mm) for new ALMA data
data.arrays: 12-m array with 43-50 antennas; ACA for HD170773 and HD161868
data.sensitivity: 12-68 uJy continuum for beams 0.2-3.1 arcsec (ALMA); 100-290 uJy for SMA

what.value: Protoplanetary ring widths (65 rings) from DSHARP, Taurus and ODISEA surveys

evidence.quote: We compile a sample of 65 protoplanetary rings from three ALMA surveys: DSHARP (cite: Huang2018), the Taurus star-forming region survey (cite: Long2018), and ODISEA

what.value: Archival ALMA, SMA, CARMA calibrated data of resolved belts

evidence.quote: For SMA and CARMA archival observations, we obtained calibrated, science-ready visibilities from PIs/co-Is of the respective projects

what.value: Stellar ages and memberships from BANYAN Sigma

evidence.quote: Membership from BANYAN Sigma (cite: Gagne2018), or moving group age also from (cite: Gagne2018)

recipe.method: Pipeline calibration, concatenation, tclean multiscale imaging
Radially and vertically Gaussian ring model from RADMC-3D images, Fourier transformed with GALARIO, fit with MCMC
key_parameters: h fixed to 0.03 unless vertically constrained; temperature r^-0.5
assumptions: Gaussian radial profile; large grains behave as blackbodies

recipe.method: Star + modified blackbody fit to multi-wavelength photometry

recipe.goal: Derive dust masses and test collisional evolution
recipe.method: Mass at 1.33 mm from flux, kappa and blackbody temperature; compare with collisional isochrones with age groups
key_parameters: t0 = 10 Myr, delta = 13/3, epsilon = 1, D ~2e-8 Myr Mearth au^-13/3

recipe.method: Synthetic populations of 1000 belts per bin passed through selection criteria

evidence.quote: with a median fractional width of 0.71

answer_key.quantity: Median fractional width of protoplanetary rings

evidence.quote: with a median fractional width of 0.18 and only 9% having values above 0.5

answer_key.quantity: Kuiper belt radius and FWHM (L7 model)

evidence.quote: estimate a central radius of 43 au and a FWHM of 12 au
We find well-constrained aspect ratios in the range between $\sim$0.01 and 0.3

not_stated_but_needed: Per-target weighting, robust and u-v taper values (only on Zenodo)
MCMC prior ranges and exact step counts per system
Line-free channels for continuum subtraction/ CO
Details of bias map selection thresholds per wavelength
Exact photometry compilations used in SED fits
missing_for_reproduction: Per-target imaging weightings and tapers (in Zenodo tables)
MCMC priors and steps per system
score_reason: Code and calibrated data released and method well described, but many per-target settings only in external tables.
rediscovery_reason: Public data and released visibilities; numeric results (R, width, h) for each belt can be re-derived.
